transcript: Did you know if you sat in silence for just 10 minutes every day with no stimulation, and stopped using your own thoughts against yourself, and stopped judging people, including yourself, and wrote down five things you are grateful for every morning before touching your phone, and walked outside for 30 minutes each day to feel the sun, the air, and reconnect with life again, and read even one page of a book each day to feed your mind wisdom instead of noise. Your life would slowly begin to change, almost immediately, my friend. And if you continued for 30 days straight, your anxiety would become quieter, your mind would feel lighter, your happiness would slowly return. Most people do not need more distraction, my friend. They need peace.
